items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: At that time, I think I would have to say Tommy Flanagan. Tommy Flanagan and Hank Jones.

ctx.x: I know you put in some years with Yusef. So we’ll come back to that. But before we ask about what influences you received from Yusef, at this stage of your development, who would you say were your major influences as far as your piano?
At that time, I think I would have to say Tommy Flanagan. Tommy Flanagan and Hank Jones.
